refresh_rate.description: Delay for update refresh rate in seconds. Default is 1.

view_mode.description: View mode (0 = kB/s, 1 = total kB, 2 = total bytes, 3 = total MB, 4 = MB/s, 5 = GB/s). Default is 0.

all_devices.description: Monitor all devices, even loopback/stopped ones.

garbage_collection_period.description: Garbage collection period in number of refreshes. Default is 50.

target_pids.description: Show only processes with the specified pid(s).

devices.description: Device(s) to monitor. Default is all interfaces up and running excluding loopback.
